column7: A panic in a pre-verdict storage call of POST /auth/webauthn/login/finish unwound past the per-IP login-attempt release and kept the slot. The handler now releases the slot on a pre-verdict panic and re-panics unchanged; TestFinishWebAuthnLogin_PanicKeepsTheSlotOnlyAfterTheVerdict pins the other half (a post-verdict panic keeps it). Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
